The '''''Dred Imperative''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] shipping refugees off the planet [[Demophon]] prior to its destruction via [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="I" />
